sheet_prompts.a:
STYLE REFERENCE (attached image): The attached image is an already-approved unit from the SAME game (warrior). Match ONLY its hand-painted 2D art style, bold dark ink outline weight, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy colour richness, silhouette readability at 48 pixels, flat #FF00FF magenta background, and saturated pure-red (#E01010) team-colour convention. DO NOT copy that character, silhouette, outfit, weapon, mount, or vehicle — draw a completely different unit matching the specification below.

ERA / VISUAL THEME: ancient labourer with a pickaxe and tool pack

I am making art for ONE unit in a family-friendly historical strategy game. Draw ONE image: the master design of this unit.
Every later image of this unit will be drawn from it, and the game will animate this drawing by cutting it into parts, so it
must follow the pose rules exactly.

THE UNIT: Worker. a rugged quarry labourer in a hand-painted historical strategy style: bare-headed with short dark hair and a red cloth headband, a plain cream linen tunic with short sleeves and a red cloth belt, rough brown trousers and leather boots, and nothing else carried; he holds one realistic short-handled iron pickaxe in his right hand, the wooden handle only about as long as his arm and a half (roughly from his hip to his shoulder), held upright at chest height with the curved iron pick head at the top, nothing like a staff; facing right, legs clearly apart in a wide stance with a visible gap between the feet, both legs straight and not touching

STYLE: clean hand-painted 2D game art, bold dark outline, flat cel shading with soft highlights, earthy saturated palette,
friendly readable proportions that still read when the unit is 48 pixels tall. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no pixel art.

VIEW: strict side view, facing RIGHT. The whole unit is inside the image with empty space of about a tenth of the image on
every side. No ground, floor, shadow, scenery, text, labels, border or effects.

BACKGROUND: one completely flat, uniform solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background filling the entire image behind the unit. NO transparency checkerboard, NO grey-and-white grid, NO gradient, NO drop shadow, NO ambient glow, NO vignette, NO soft semi-transparent edges. Every outline, smoke puff, flame, dust cloud, or effect must be 100% solid, opaque, and hard-edged with a clean dark ink outline against the #FF00FF magenta so nothing blends into purple. Put nothing magenta, pink, or purple anywhere on the unit.

TEAM COLOUR: paint the red headband and the belt saturated pure red (#E01010). That is the ONLY red or red-orange anywhere in the image.
Everything else (skin, hair, leather, wood, metal, stains) is brown, tan, grey, black, white, bronze or dull dark maroon. The game recolours that red to
each player's colour, so any other red would change colour too.

POSE FOR ANIMATION (the most important part):
- Standing at rest, weight on both feet, both feet flat on the ground with a gap of about one boot length between them,
  knees straight, body upright.
- The garment ends above the knee, so both legs show below the hem as two separate shapes that do not touch.
- Nothing hangs in front of or behind the legs below the hem: shield, cloak, quiver, scabbard, pouches and sash all stay above
  the hem.
- He grips the short pickaxe handle at chest height in his right hand with the pick head pointing up near his shoulder, well clear of the boots; the whole tool is shorter than half his body height.

   slump shows only in the head, shoulders and arms. In every frame the two legs are separate posts with a visible gap of
